title: Wizard step
summary: One step of sf-wizard: its key, label, title, «why», type, optional, address in place pages, primary label and result line as attributes, its state as a value, and its body -- a form, a picture, a plan of changes -- as its children, which stay where the page put them.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

name.description: The step's key: what current names, what events carry, the key of its answers in the wizard's value. Its place (step-1, step-2 …) when empty.

label.description: The step's short name in the progress («Адрес панели»).

heading.description: The step's title over its body; the label when empty.

description.description: Why the step is there, one or two sentences under the title.

type.description: What the step does, and so its primary button: info shows (Далее); form takes fields and validates them (Далее saves the step); action runs a long action (Запустить, then Далее; Повторить after an error); review shows what will be done with a way back to each step (Применить); result says what happened (Готово).

optional.description: The step may be skipped: the wizard draws «Пропустить», and a skipped step reads skipped.

href.description: Place pages: the step's own address. Back and a press on the step in the progress go there.

action-text.description: The primary button's label on this step («Выпустить сертификат», «Импортировать»); the type's word when empty. Retry and the move on after an action keep their own words.

message.description: What the step's action came to, one sentence: drawn as sf-alert in the step, success while the step is done, error while it is error. While running, the line beside the indicator.

state.description: Where the step stands: empty (not started), done, skipped, running (its action is under way) or error. The host writes it; in places inline and modal the wizard also writes done and skipped when a person moves on.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: running the step's action (the host or the server does)

accessibility.focus: The step takes no focus; its controls are the page's.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-wizard-step only inside sf-wizard, one per step.
do_not: Do not draw the step's title or buttons inside the body; the wizard draws them from the attributes
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-wizard-step name="address" label="Адрес панели" type="form" description="По этому адресу вы будете открывать панель."><form><sf-input name="host" label="Адрес" required></sf-input></form></sf-wizard-step>
